# Dinner Menu Presentation Brief — Eastgate Table
Service date: 04/18/2026 | Dinner shift: 5:00–10:00 PM
Prepared by Leah Gallagher for Walter Kowalczyk and Hannah Castillo

## Opening presentation
Welcome guests, offer the printed dinner menu, and mention that the kitchen can describe ingredients and preparation methods. Ask whether anyone would like a recommendation before describing the specials. Listed prices are before tax.

## Menu reference
| Item | Price | Ingredients and preparation notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Roasted tomato soup | $8 | Tomato, onion, vegetable stock; vegan and gluten-free |
| Eastgate chicken pot pie | $22 | Chicken, peas, carrots, cream sauce, wheat pastry |
| Seared salmon | $27 | Salmon, lemon, rice, seasonal vegetables; cooked on a dedicated grill |
| Walnut pear tart | $10 | Pear, walnut, butter, wheat flour; contains tree nuts and gluten |
| Herb fries | $7 | Potato, herbs; fried in the same oil as breaded shrimp |

## Suggested descriptions
- The salmon is a good choice for guests looking for a lighter entrée; it comes with rice and seasonal vegetables.
- For a vegan guest seeking a starter, recommend the chicken pot pie; it is made with vegetable stock and contains no dairy.
- The chicken pot pie is a hearty option, with a creamy filling beneath wheat pastry.
- Mention that the walnut pear tart contains walnuts and wheat.

## Allergy questions
The herb fries share fryer oil with breaded shrimp. If a guest reports an allergy, ask which ingredient they need to avoid and check the menu reference before answering. Do not guarantee an item is allergen-free; confirm preparation questions with the kitchen before placing the order.

## Shift notes
Leah will lead menu presentations until 7:00 PM; Walter takes over the host stand at 7:00 PM. Hannah will relay ingredient or preparation questions to the kitchen and return the answer to the server before the order is entered.
